data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for jailbreak and root detection on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It checks if the device is rooted on Android or jailbroken on iOS. It can also detect developer mode on Android.
use_when: You need to secure a financial or sensitive application by preventing execution on rooted or jailbroken devices
You need to check if developer mode is enabled on Android
avoid_when: You do not require device security checks
You need native custom root detection logic not covered by Rootbeer or IOSSecuritySuite
strengths: Wraps well-known native security libraries (Rootbeer and IOSSecuritySuite)
weaknesses: Root and jailbreak detection can often be bypassed by advanced users or customized tooling
Platform capabilities vary (e.g., developer mode is Android only)
